build_fuse_gmock: build fused gmock and gtest files into a single output directory for easy testing
create_fused_gmock_h: create a fused gmock/gmock.h header by scanning gmock root and resolving all includes
create_fused_gmock_gtest_all_cc: create a fused gmock-gtest-all.cc file combining gtest-all.cc and gmock-all.cc
run_fuse_gmock_cli: run fuse_gmock_files.py with gmock root dir and output dir as command line arguments
validate_gmock_root_dir: validate that a gmock root directory contains the required seed files and valid gtest
